purpose: Bounded CPU context-projection adaptation on verified CT features; no deployment or speed claim.
target: Fixed CT MXFP4 experts plus the previously tested native MXFP8 KDA conversion
frozen: All original drafter tensors, FP8 backbone codes/scales, selector, target embedding/head and target weights.

data.training_order: One seeded permutation of the 32 frozen training prompts, one prompt per step.
data.anchor_sampling: Deterministic per prompt ID, split and seed; evenly spread eligible anchors for validation, seeded uniform sample for training.
data.labels: Verified CT response token IDs, never source-dataset answers.
data.natural_stop: Only complete seven-label draft blocks before or ending at the first EOS are eligible.
data.short_response_policy: Report and skip prompts with fewer than eight response tokens before/including EOS; no replacement.
data.mask_policy: Each block sees only target context strictly before its anchor and its own eight query slots; no other block or future context.
data.query_policy: True anchor token followed by seven mask-token embeddings.
data.required_before_training: All captured hashes/controls and both ranks verified; source weights hashed; masks checked independently; each single-block explicit mask must reproduce the upstream inference mask exactly.
data.anchor_execution: Each of the four anchors uses its own eight-query-row forward. Concatenate hidden outputs for the unchanged per-prompt objective. No packed multi-block model forward.

loss.unary: Full-vocabulary cross-entropy against each verified CT label.
loss.selector: Teacher-forced cross-entropy within strict unary top-16, only where the label is present; no label injection.
loss.position_weights: Uniform across the seven draft positions.
loss.normalization: Mean unary CE plus mean covered selector CE.

validation.short_response_adjustment: Also evaluate the last eligible training step if skipped short responses leave fewer than 32 steps.
validation.weight_precision: Evaluate the BF16-rounded exported context projection.
validation.aggregation: Mean prompt scores within each domain.
validation.selection: Highest code mean prefix among checkpoints with strictly better code prefix than baseline, chat/explanation prefix ratios at least 0.98, and context-weight relative L2 at most 0.01; tie-break lower code unary CE, then earlier step.
validation.insufficient_domain_policy: No candidate if any validation domain has no eligible prompts.
validation.baseline_repeat: Exactly repeated baseline on fixed validation inputs before training.

export.all_other_tensor_payloads: Byte-identical to the original FP8 checkpoint.
export.no_improving_candidate: Preserve failure and do not promote or open sealed test.

limits: Small public short-prompt pilot; not a final quality or speed qualification.
Dense CPU training arithmetic differs from native FP8 Marlin and KV/head adapters.
The original sealed end-to-end success thresholds and failed target KL gate are unchanged.
The previous disposable MSE update is excluded.
supersedes: V2 CPU run retained and stopped after one completed update because the first step took 169.925 seconds in BF16 CPU GEMM backward. V3 restarts from the original checkpoint.
derivative_contract: Forward remains torch.nn.functional.linear with original BF16 operands. Analytical input/weight/bias derivatives use FP32 matrix products and return original dtypes. This changes backward accumulation rounding only; no claim of identical gradients. Full baseline losses and proposal metrics must equal V2 exactly.
